definitions.title: Integration by Parts Formula
definitions.latex: \int u \, dv = u v - \int v \, du
definitions.statement: Derived from the Product Rule of differentiation d(uv) = u dv + v du. Enables transforming an integral of a product into an easier integral by differentiating u and integrating dv.
conditions: u and v are continuously differentiable
definitions.explanation: Priority for choosing u follows LIATE rule: Logarithmic, Inverse trig, Algebraic, Trigonometric, Exponential.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Integration by parts is the integral calculus reversal of the product rule.

definitions.title: Tabular Integration by Parts
definitions.latex: \int f(x) g(x) dx = f(x) G_1(x) - f'(x) G_2(x) + f''(x) G_3(x) - \dots
definitions.statement: A rapid systematic algorithm for repeated integration by parts where polynomial f(x) is repeatedly differentiated until 0, and g(x) is repeatedly integrated.
conditions: g(x) is repeatedly integrable (sin, cos, exp)
definitions.explanation: Eliminates repetitive bookkeeping and sign errors.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Tabular method executes repeated integration by parts instantly.
